name: Settings placement help
description: Help mode entries for the Settings placement plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Settings placement
entries.text: Where each plugin's settings open when you tap its gear or its Settings item: inside the plugin, a pop-up dialog, a floating window or the main Settings page. They always stay in Settings too.

entries.title: Sync now
entries.text: Fetches the picks saved on the console server now, so a change made in another browser or by Claude shows here at once.
